functionDescriptions: Protein that plays a role in the inhibition of canonical Wnt signaling pathway (PubMed:25557784). May be involved in neuronal migration during development of the cerebral neocortex (By similarity). Involved in the control of ciliogenesis and ciliary length (PubMed:25601850, PubMed:27319779). {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:D3ZR10, ECO:0000269|PubMed:25557784, ECO:0000269|PubMed:25601850, ECO:0000269|PubMed:27319779}.
